newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Big Flower Q2 net falls.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Big Flower Q2 net falls.

text.p: (Dollars and Shares In Thousands, Except Per Share Data)
NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF OPERATIONS FOR THE THREE

(a) Effective October 4, 1996, Scanforms Inc. merged with a wholly-owned subsidiary of Big Flower, and Big Flower issued approximately 1.6 million shares of common stock to the shareholders of Scanforms. The merger was accounted for using the pooling of interests method, and all Big Flower historical information has been restated as if the pooling occurred at the beginning of the periods presented here. All other acquisitions have been included as of their respective transaction dates.

(b) 1997 adjusted results exclude costs associated with the Company's secondary offering in June 1997 of $.6 million and the related tax effect thereof. In addition, the Company terminated a revolving credit facility which generated an extraordinary loss of $3.0 million (net of income tax benefit of $1.9 million) which is excluded.
(c) Other, net includes $1.4 million and $1.2 million in costs of accounts receivable sales in 1997 and 1996, respectively.
(d) "EBITDA" represents operating income plus depreciation, amortization of intangibles and merger costs ($.1 million in the second quarter of 1996).
(Dollars and Shares In Thousands, Except Per Share Data)
NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF OPERATIONS FOR THE SIX

(a) Effective October 4, 1996, Scanforms, Inc. merged with a wholly-owned subsidiary of Big Flower, and Big Flower issued approximately 1.6 million shares of common stock to the shareholders of Scanforms. The merger was accounted for using the pooling of interests method, and all Big Flower historical information has been restated as if the pooling occurred at the beginning of the periods presented here. All other acquisitions have been included as of their respective transaction dates.

(b) 1997 adjusted results exclude costs associated with the Company's secondary offering in June 1997 of $.6 million and the related tax effect thereof. In addition, the Company terminated a revolving credit facility which generated an extraordinary loss of $3.0 million (net of income tax benefit of $1.9 million) which is excluded.
(c) 1996 adjusted results take into consideration the following items:
(1) Other, net reflects the exclusion of $5.0 million of non-recurring charges related to financing transactions in connection with the acquisition of Webcraft Technologies, Inc.

(2) Subsequent to its acquisition of Webcraft, the Company repaid certain outstanding debt at a premium which generated an extraordinary loss of $1.9 million (net of income tax benefit of $1.3 million ) which is excluded.
(3) Selling, general and administrative expenses reflect the exclusion of merger costs of $.1 million related to the acquisition of Scanforms.
(4) Income tax expense (benefit) has been adjusted for the non-recurring charges.
(d) Other, net includes $2.9 million and $1.4 million in costs of accounts receivable sales in 1997 and adjusted 1996, respectively.
(e) "EBITDA" represents operating income plus depreciation, amortization of intangibles and merger costs ($.1 million in the second quarter of 1996).
